context.transcript:
Good afternoon.
At today's meeting, I'd like to focus on ticket sales.
As you know, sales have been declining.
We continue to offer top-quality films, but the availability of online entertainment options is responsible for this decline.
We've lost young moviegoers in particular.
So today I want you to brainstorm ways we could attract a greater turnout to our theater, especially a younger audience.
But before we begin, we'll take a look at the annual report to review our income and expenses.
Let me just bring the figures up on my laptop so we can all view them on the screen.
context.transcript_translation:
大家下午好。
今天的会议，我想重点讨论电影票销售情况。
如各位所知，票房销售一直在下滑。
我们仍然在放映高质量的影片，但网络娱乐选择的普及造成了销量下降。
我们尤其流失了年轻的观影人群。
因此，今天我希望大家集思广益，想想怎样才能吸引更多观众来我们影院，尤其是年轻观众。
不过，在开始讨论之前，我们先看看年度报告，回顾一下收入和支出。
我先在笔记本电脑上调出这些数据，这样大家就都能在屏幕上看到。
